layout: 3 columns × 2 rows; neutral, greet, joy, smug, shock, cry

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production chibi character sprite atlas for a Chinese mahjong game's card backs, avatars and emote stickers. Create original fan-art of the specified Slay the Spire character, recognizable to the game. Polished cute anime chibi, oversized head and tiny body, crisp dark brown outlines, softly shaded painted cel colors, slightly warm highlights, readable at thumbnail size, consistent character identity across all six cells.
COMPOSITION IS CRITICAL: landscape 3:2 canvas, exactly three equal columns and two equal rows of square cells (ideally 1536 x 1024). Six separate full-body poses, one centered in each cell, no overlap. Each figure fits entirely inside the central 78 percent of its own cell, including weapons, effects and emote symbols. Leave a large transparent gutter around every pose. No grid lines or panels. Actual transparent alpha background everywhere outside the characters. Do not paint checkerboard, floor, colored background, shadows outside the figure, card frames, writing, letters, captions, logos or watermark.
Reading order, left-to-right:
TOP LEFT: calm signature standing pose, full body, suitable for a card-back portrait.
TOP MIDDLE: friendly greeting, one hand raised in a wave.
TOP RIGHT: delighted laughter / celebratory happiness, expressive body pose and tiny sparkle accents.
BOTTOM LEFT: confident smug triumph, arms crossed or a thumbs up.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: startled shocked reaction, small exclamation-shaped non-text rays and wide expression.
BOTTOM RIGHT: comically crying, big stylized tears, adorable not distressed.
Keep the costume and anatomy consistent, two arms maximum. Put every character's feet at the same level within its cell. Strong clean silhouette.
SUBJECT: THE IRONCLAD / 战士: a compact white-haired warrior wearing his distinctive brass/gold face mask with narrow dark eye slits, gold shoulder armor, dark forest-green tunic, red pants and red scarf, brown gloves and boots, a broad straight steel sword with a simple crossguard. Red/ember accent colors. TOP LEFT signature pose: holds the sword diagonally at his side, brave but cute. Keep mask on all six poses, convey emotions through eye slits and body language.
